formula: net_import_share = (consumption - production) / consumption, per fuel (oil, gas, coal), TWh; positive = net importer. balance = (consumption - production) / (consumption + production), bounded -1..1, used only where a bounded number is needed. A blank production or consumption cell in the source -> VOID for that fuel-year, never 0.
licence_note: derived from Our World in Data (CC BY 4.0), built on the Energy Institute Statistical Review; a null is a blank in the source
record: annual energy net import share and balance by fuel
units: TWh; shares and balances are fractions
